parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale properly addresses all listed error targets. It corrects the claim that naming method variants constitutes identifying a specific part of the paper, instead explaining that the location is not identifiable. It correctly notes that the comment does specify what needs to be addressed (lack of biological foundation, need for discussion of biological plausibility). It avoids stating a numeric final score or gold label, using descriptive language about rubric levels instead. The rationale preserves the valid observation about what the comment specifies while fixing the errors related to grounding and rubric application.
